about_the_game:
Build Your Criminal Empire
Recruit members, plan crimes, and expand your territory—carve out your underworld kingdom in a city teetering between order and chaos. From drug trafficking and theft to shady dealings, amass your wealth through illegal means. But to survive, you’ll need to outsmart rival gangs and stay one step ahead of relentless law enforcement.

Create Your Own Gang
Choose from historically-inspired criminal organizations and shape a unique faction. Each archetype comes with its own ideology tree and strategic bonuses that define your path to dominance.

Expand Your Base, Recruit Elite Members
Upgrade your hideouts and expand facilities to strengthen your gang. Recruit skilled specialists—each with unique abilities—to gain the upper hand in your climb to power.

Build a Black Market Empire and Reap Huge Profits
Basic operations like theft and protection rackets keep your gang running, but the real money comes from operating casinos, producing and trafficking drugs, alcohol, and contraband cigarettes. Unlock these high-risk, high-reward businesses to rise above the rest.

The Police Aren’t Just for Show—and Neither Are Rival Gangs
This city is no safe haven. Law enforcement will raid your operations and arrest your crew. Meanwhile, rival gangs lie in wait, ready to seize your territory. In a world full of threats, only the sharpest and most ruthless can claim the crown of the underworld.

content_descriptors.notes: Involves the production and trafficking of drugs, alcohol, and cigarettes.
